entities.description: A close-up view of a vertical, metallic flagpole featuring a smooth, cylindrical shaft with a subtle vertical highlight. The pole is topped with a polished, golden spherical finial resting on a small decorative collar. A portion of a blue flag is visible on the right side, attached to the pole with small metal rings.

A weathered white marble statue of a young man with curly hair, wearing a draped toga with a brooch on the shoulder, holding a scroll in his right hand and a staff in his left, set against a backdrop of a waving French flag.

clothing.details: draped over left shoulder, fastened with a circular brooch, gathered at the waist

attributes.pose: standing, facing slightly to the right
attributes.background: French flag (blue, white, red) waving in the wind
